title: Keep wait marks on Paseo system prompts and keep tests off the real daemon
judge_obligation_ack: the leader, a different model from the worker, reads the prompt_context diff and runs the tests before cap
action:
Per decision f247ae6c. (1) In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/src/hooks/prompt_context.rs, in execute() (about line 371), call the clear part of clear_and_reap_waiting_on_best_effort only when the prompt is a human prompt: a prompt is NOT human when ctx.payload's "prompt" string, after trim_start, starts with "<paseo-system>". On a non-human prompt still run crate::verbs::workflow_store::reap_stale_waiting_on (split the function so the reap always runs and the two clears are skipped). A missing or non-string prompt counts as human, so today's behavior holds. Test red first beside run_clears_a_live_default_waiting_on_mark_through_the_real_hook_entry_point (about line 2755): the same fixture with payload {cwd, prompt: "<paseo-system>
Schedule "bee-leader" fired (id=x, run=y).
bee heartbeat
</paseo-system>"} keeps the live mark; and a plain prompt {cwd, prompt: "ok"} still clears it. (2) In packages/bee-rs/crates/bee/tests/pi_plugin_contracts.rs, in run_harness_spec_with_env (about line 1162), also env_remove PASEO_AGENT_ID, PASEO_AGENT_CWD and PASEO_CLI before the env_vars loop, so a test that needs one passes it through env_vars. Check every test that relies on an inherited PASEO_* value still passes; any Command::new of the bee binary in that file that loads the extension gets the same three env_remove calls. Write no code comments.
verify: PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --bin bee prompt_context && PATH="${CARGO_HOME:-$HOME/.cargo}/bin:$PATH" cargo test --release --manifest-path packages/bee-rs/Cargo.toml -p bee --test pi_plugin_contracts

truths: a <paseo-system> prompt keeps a live waiting_on mark
a human prompt still clears a live waiting_on mark
the stale-mark reap still runs on every prompt
pi_plugin_contracts never passes the caller's PASEO_AGENT_ID, PASEO_AGENT_CWD or PASEO_CLI to the extension
prohibitions: no change to the Stop hook turn-end logic
no text heuristic beyond the <paseo-system> prefix
